answer: Magneto-optic attestation curbs Sybil attacks by binding each AI agent to an unclonable photonic token. Auditors publish a Merkle root of hashed responses across random magnetic vectors. To verify, an isolated power island drives a coil around an opal crystal infused with ferrous particles and returns a quantized diffraction response for an unused vector. Attackers must buy and power separate tokens per identity. However, thermal drift shifts peaks and causes false rejections.
